† [עָתֹד] vb. be ready (NH adj. עָתִיד future (as prepared); Arabic عَتُدَ be ready, prepared (also great, bulky); Syriac ܥܬܰܕ, 𝔗 in der. spec. and deriv.);—
Pi. Imv. ms. sf. וְעַתְּדָתּ Pr 24:27 and make it ready i.e. thy work (‖ הָכֵן).
Hithp. Pf. 3 pl. הִתְעַתְּדוּ לְגַלִּים Jb 15:28 which [houses] were prepared (destined) for (i.e. to be) heaps of ruin.
